name: Demonic Spirits
overview: Scripture reveals that demonic spirits are unclean and deceptive forces opposed to God’s truth, as seen in the warnings against seeking familiar spirits or wizards (Leviticus 19:31; 20:6) and the call to avoid the abominable practices of pagan nations (Deuteronomy 18:9). Jesus describes unclean spirits as restless and destructive (Matthew 12:43), while John identifies the devil as the father of lies and a murderer from the beginning (John 8:44). In contrast to these forces that steal, kill, and destroy, Christ came to offer abundant life (John 10:10), underscoring the spiritual battle between darkness and the life-giving power of God.
